opt.deviceHint: Discord, CS2 and other apps see it as “CABLE Output”.
opt.trayHint: The X button hides the window instead of quitting
opt.listenHint: Start listening as soon as CoMic opens
fx.title: Voice effects
fx.subFree: Pirate and Grandpa are free. Click a voice to switch, or switch it from your phone.
fx.subPro: Applied live to the virtual microphone. Pick a voice, then adjust it below.
fine.title: Fine tuning
fine.mixHint: This voice changes pitch. Below 100% you hear two voices at once, so use Pitch instead.
fine.lowCutHint: Removes rumble, wind and desk thumps.
fine.highCutHint: Removes hiss and harsh S sounds.
adv.title: Advanced
adv.driveHint: Distortion. Higher is rougher and louder.
adv.locked: Get Pro in the phone app to unlock these. One purchase works on the PC too.
help.title: Get started
help.sub: Three steps to use your phone as a microphone.
help.s1d: Keep the phone and the PC on the same Wi-Fi, or plug in a USB cable.
help.s2d: A free virtual audio cable from vb-cable.com. CoMic plays into it. Restart Windows after installing.
help.s3d: In Discord, CS2 or Chrome, choose CABLE Output as the microphone.
help.trouble: No sound or crackling? Read this
ph.ready.title: Ready to stream
ph.ready.wifi: Tap Start, then connect from CoMic on your PC.
ph.ready.usb: Plug the phone into your PC, then tap Start.
ph.ready.bt: Tap Start, then pick this phone on your laptop.
ph.waiting.title: Waiting for your PC…
ph.mutedSub: Tap to unmute. Your PC hears silence.
ph.liveSub: Tap the button to mute. It keeps working with the screen off.
ph.notListed: Not listed? Some routers block discovery. Type the address above in CoMic on your PC.
ph.adbDesc: Developer options, then USB debugging. The most reliable way. CoMic on the PC does the rest.
ph.tetherDesc: No developer options needed. The phone shares its connection over the cable.
ph.btWarn: Pair the phone in Windows Bluetooth settings first. Bluetooth has the highest latency (100 to 200 ms), so use it mainly on laptops.
ph.fxSubFree: Pirate and Grandpa are free. Tap a voice and it plays on your PC.
ph.fxSubPro: Tap a voice and it plays on your PC right away.
ph.connectHint: Connect to a PC to hear the voice live.
ph.tuneHintPro: Sliders stay where you leave them. Your PC hears the change right away.
ph.tuneHintFree: With Pro you can move every slider and keep your own settings for each voice.
ph.err.noPc: Pick a PC from the list, or type its address.
ph.err.port: The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
ph.err.noMic: Without microphone access there is nothing to send.
ph.err.noAnswer: No PC answered. Type the address by hand.
ph.link.silent: No answer from {target}. Is CoMic open on the PC?
ph.readyPick: Pick your PC below, then tap Start.
ph.notListedHand: Not listed? Some routers block discovery. Type the address by hand.
ph.tetherOn: On. The phone is {ip} on the cable. Search for PCs above, or type the cable address of the PC.
ph.tetherOff: Off. Turn it on and the cable becomes a small network. Everything then works like Wi-Fi, only faster.
ph.adbWhy: Needs the TCP control channel: adb only forwards TCP, and we send UDP.
ph.noLoopback: CoMic cannot confirm the PC is hearing this yet. The phone only sends. The TCP control channel will close that loop.
ph.soonEffects: Not built yet. Picking a voice from the phone needs the TCP control channel: right now the phone only sends audio one way and has no way to tell the PC anything. Until then, change the voice in CoMic on the PC.
ph.tuneOnPc: These live on the PC. The phone can neither read them nor move them until the control channel exists.
pro.title: Every voice, tuned your way
pro.perk1: All voices, plus new ones in updates
pro.perk2: Adjust pitch, grit, wobble and more
pro.perk3: One purchase for phone and PC

set.pairingHint: Encrypted. Nobody else on the Wi-Fi can listen.
set.callsHint: Resume on its own after a phone call
set.screenOffHint: Keeps the mic working in your pocket
set.notifHint: Mute and stop without opening the app
set.batteryOk: Not restricted. Android won't stop CoMic.
set.batteryBad: Restricted. Android may stop CoMic in the background.
